chunks.title: CNC Spindle 200 Maintenance Manual
chunks.text: If vibration RMS rises more than 30% within 24 h together with kurtosis above 4, inspect the rear bearing (6205-2RS). Continued operation above 4.5 mm/s may cause seizure within 48–96 h. Reducing spindle speed to 70% lowers bearing load and extends safe run time.

chunks.title: Work order: Spindle 2 rear bearing failure
chunks.text: Vibration rose ~120% over 3 days before seizure; rear bearing outer race worn.

chunks.title: CNC Spindle 200 Maintenance Manual
chunks.text: Misalignment shows as high vibration at 2× running speed with normal kurtosis.
